lines.text: Work judged by eye or ear (a render, image, animation, sound) starts with its doctrine, before the first change: /agentic-engineering:design.
A metric that moved is not a verdict: open the picture yourself and classify the difference (wrong, less-plausible, more-correct, different-ok, noise, stale).
Defects are yours to fix; taste (how bright, how much, which of two plausible looks) is the owner's to decide.

Render the smallest run that answers the question: 1 to 3 proving shots per iteration, the whole suite once at the end. The gate compares a candidate with its own accepted run; never set a target against the reference.
An owed full run or a stale baseline becomes a gate card (`aw board owe`), and a render only one session may run goes under /agentic-engineering:agents locks.
A ruling with reach (how every sky looks) becomes a decision record via /agentic-engineering:planning spec-edit.
